input.content: Pattern: Client enforces a new protocol field before the counterpart that emits it is deployed — breaks independently-releasable compatibility. In enhanced-settings Task 1, client.save_settings sent `require_receipt: True` unconditionally and raised when `response.get("applied") is not True`. The provider that emits `applied` was Task 2 (pending, separate repo). Result: every ordinary save against the currently-deployed provider raises, violating "ordinary saves must keep working with the supported provider" and "independently releasable" constraints. Severity P0. Detection cue: a client increment hard-requires a response field that is part of a not-yet-shipped server increment. Fix patterns: tolerate missing field (only enforce when key present), and/or gate the new requirement behind the feature flag (which was disabled by default here, `enhanced_settings`).
